title: Wizard Horse at Enchanted Gate
description: A brown horse wearing glasses and a blue wizard robe sits on a wooden crate writing with a quill in an open book. Behind him is a vibrant magical explosion of fire, smoke, and colorful energy, with a classical temple floating in the dark sky above. To the left stands a stone archway with a rainbow-colored broken door featuring cauldrons and potion symbols, surrounded by glowing runes and scattered debris.
prompt: Anthropomorphic brown horse wizard with round glasses wearing flowing blue robes sits on a wooden crate writing in a large book with a quill, dramatic magical explosion of orange fire black smoke green energy and colorful sparks erupting behind him, classical greek temple floating in the stormy night sky, ancient stone archway on the left with shattered rainbow stained glass door showing potion cauldrons and alchemical symbols, glowing purple runes floating in the air, scattered rubble and debris on the ground, vibrant fantasy scene
